quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Ben forgot his umbrella at home this morning. By the time he reached the bus stop, his jacket and shoes were completely wet.
options: Ben's jacket was clean and dry all day.
Ben went swimming on his way to work.
It was raining outside.
The bus arrived exactly on time.
quests.correctAnswer: It was raining outside.
quests.hint: Think about what could make a person's clothes wet on the way to a bus stop.
quests.explanation: Ben's jacket and shoes got wet on his way outside, and he had left his umbrella at home. Rain is the only detail that explains this, so that is the conclusion the passage supports.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Grandma put a fresh apple pie on the kitchen window to cool. Ten minutes later, the pie was gone, and the dog's face was covered in crumbs.
options: Grandma ate the pie herself.
The dog ate the pie.
The pie disappeared by magic.
The window was left open all winter.
quests.correctAnswer: The dog ate the pie.
quests.hint: Look closely at what was found on the dog's face.
quests.explanation: The pie vanished, and the dog's face had crumbs on it. This detail points to the dog as the one who ate it.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Every Sunday, Mr. Lopez calls his daughter in another city. Today he dialed her number three times, but nobody answered.
options: Mr. Lopez forgot his daughter's phone number.
Mr. Lopez's daughter was not available today.
Mr. Lopez's daughter no longer has a phone.
Mr. Lopez decided to stop calling his daughter.
quests.correctAnswer: Mr. Lopez's daughter was not available today.
quests.hint: Think about why calling three times might not get an answer.
quests.explanation: Mr. Lopez tried calling three times and no one picked up. This shows his daughter simply wasn't available, not that anything else was wrong.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Every student in Ms. Chen's class scored above 90 on the science test. Ms. Chen smiled and told the class she was proud of their hard work.
options: Ms. Chen was disappointed with the results.
Only one student passed the test.
The class did very well on the test.
The test was cancelled at the last minute.
quests.correctAnswer: The class did very well on the test.
quests.hint: Notice the scores everyone received and how the teacher reacted.
quests.explanation: Every student scored above 90, and the teacher was proud. Both details show that the class performed very well.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The shoes Amir wanted were $80 last week. When he checked the store today, the price tag read $50.
options: The shoes are more expensive than last week.
The store stopped selling shoes.
The shoes are now cheaper than before.
Amir already bought the shoes last week.
quests.correctAnswer: The shoes are now cheaper than before.
quests.hint: Compare the two prices Amir saw.
quests.explanation: The price dropped from $80 to $50, so the shoes now cost less than they did last week.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Sara's phone battery usually lasts all day. Yesterday, after she used a new game app for two hours, her phone died by lunchtime.
options: Sara's phone is broken and needs to be replaced.
Sara forgot to charge her phone the night before.
The new app made Sara's phone charge faster.
The new game app used a lot of battery power.
quests.correctAnswer: The new game app used a lot of battery power.
quests.hint: Think about what changed in Sara's routine right before her phone died early.
quests.explanation: Sara's phone normally lasts all day, but it died early only after she played the new game for two hours. This points to the app using extra battery power.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The Kim family arrived at the airport two hours early for their flight. When they reached the check-in desk, they found out the flight had been delayed by three hours.
options: The Kim family will have to wait longer than expected.
The Kim family missed their flight completely.
The airport closed early that day.
The flight left earlier than planned.
quests.correctAnswer: The Kim family will have to wait longer than expected.
quests.hint: Think about what a three-hour delay means for people who already arrived early.
quests.explanation: The family arrived early, but the flight was delayed three hours, so now they must wait even longer at the airport.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Diego stayed up until 2 a.m. playing video games three nights in a row. By Thursday, he could barely keep his eyes open at work.
options: Diego was very tired because he didn't get enough sleep.
Diego felt full of energy on Thursday.
Diego's workplace turned off the lights.
Video games always make people sleepy.
quests.correctAnswer: Diego was very tired because he didn't get enough sleep.
quests.hint: Think about how staying up late for three nights would affect someone the next day.
quests.explanation: Diego lost sleep for three nights, and by Thursday he was exhausted at work. Lack of sleep is the clear reason for his tiredness.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Tickets for the new movie sold out within one hour of going on sale. The theater added three extra showtimes to meet the demand.
options: The movie was very popular with audiences.
Nobody wanted to watch the movie.
The theater decided to cancel the movie.
The movie tickets were free for everyone.
quests.correctAnswer: The movie was very popular with audiences.
quests.hint: Notice how quickly the tickets disappeared and what the theater did next.
quests.explanation: Tickets sold out in an hour, and the theater had to add more showtimes. Both facts show that many people wanted to see the movie.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Every night, Mrs. Osei sets three alarms on her phone. This morning, she still woke up twenty minutes after she needed to leave for work.
options: Mrs. Osei arrived at work early today.
Mrs. Osei's phone has no alarm feature.
Even with three alarms, Mrs. Osei overslept.
Mrs. Osei decided to skip work today.
quests.correctAnswer: Even with three alarms, Mrs. Osei overslept.
quests.hint: Compare the time she needed to leave with the time she actually woke up.
quests.explanation: She set three alarms, yet she still woke up twenty minutes late. This shows that despite her efforts, she overslept.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Two new employees joined the sales team in March. By June, the team's monthly sales numbers had doubled.
options: The new employees likely helped increase sales.
The sales team lost most of its customers.
The company closed the sales department.
Sales numbers stayed exactly the same.
quests.correctAnswer: The new employees likely helped increase sales.
quests.hint: Think about what changed on the team right before the sales numbers grew.
quests.explanation: Sales doubled soon after two new employees joined the team, suggesting their work contributed to the improvement.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The restaurant switched to a new vegetable supplier last month. Since then, customers have been leaving more five-star reviews than ever before.
options: Customers stopped visiting the restaurant.
The new vegetables may have improved customers' experience.
The restaurant removed vegetables from its menu.
Reviews have nothing to do with the food.
quests.correctAnswer: The new vegetables may have improved customers' experience.
quests.hint: Notice what changed right before the reviews got better.
quests.explanation: Right after switching vegetable suppliers, the restaurant started getting more five-star reviews. This suggests the change made a positive difference for customers.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The Rivera brothers argue about which video game to play almost every weekend. Last Saturday, they spent the whole afternoon playing board games together and laughing.
options: The brothers fought more than usual last Saturday.
The brothers got along better than usual last Saturday.
The brothers stopped speaking to each other.
The brothers sold all of their video games.
quests.correctAnswer: The brothers got along better than usual last Saturday.
quests.hint: Compare their usual weekend behavior with what happened last Saturday.
quests.explanation: Unlike their usual arguing, the brothers spent Saturday playing together happily, showing they got along unusually well that day.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Leila studied only thirty minutes for her math test, while her classmate Noor studied every night for a week. On test day, Noor answered every question with confidence.
options: Noor's extra preparation likely helped her feel confident.
Leila studied more than Noor did.
Noor did not take the test.
Studying has no effect on test performance.
quests.correctAnswer: Noor's extra preparation likely helped her feel confident.
quests.hint: Think about the connection between how much Noor studied and how she felt on test day.
quests.explanation: Noor studied far more than Leila and felt confident during the test, showing that her extra preparation likely paid off.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The bakery normally sells out of bread by 10 a.m. On the day it rained heavily, there was still bread left on the shelves at closing time.
options: More customers visited the bakery than usual.
The bakery baked less bread than normal.
The bakery closed early because of the rain.
Fewer customers visited the bakery on the rainy day.
quests.correctAnswer: Fewer customers visited the bakery on the rainy day.
quests.hint: Think about how weather might affect how many people go out shopping.
quests.explanation: Bread that usually sells out by morning was still there at closing, suggesting the rain kept many customers away that day.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: After the app added a night mode feature, the number of people using it late at night increased sharply.
options: The night mode feature made people stop using the app.
The app removed all its features that month.
The night mode feature likely encouraged more nighttime use.
Nighttime use of the app decreased after the update.
quests.correctAnswer: The night mode feature likely encouraged more nighttime use.
quests.hint: Notice what changed in the app right before nighttime use went up.
quests.explanation: Use at night increased right after the night mode feature was added, suggesting the new feature attracted more nighttime users.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The mountain road was closed for repairs all week. Drivers heading to the village had to take a route that added two extra hours to their trip.
options: The trip to the village became shorter.
The mountain road was open as usual.
Drivers stopped traveling to the village completely.
Getting to the village took longer than usual that week.
quests.correctAnswer: Getting to the village took longer than usual that week.
quests.hint: Think about what a two-hour detour means for travel time.
quests.explanation: With the main road closed, drivers had to use a longer route, adding two hours to their trip to the village.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Since Marco started walking to work instead of driving, his doctor has noted his blood pressure has slowly returned to a normal range.
options: Marco's blood pressure got worse after he started walking.
Marco stopped seeing his doctor.
Driving to work always lowers blood pressure.
Walking to work may have helped improve Marco's health.
quests.correctAnswer: Walking to work may have helped improve Marco's health.
quests.hint: Look at what changed in Marco's routine and what his doctor observed afterward.
quests.explanation: After Marco switched from driving to walking, his blood pressure improved, suggesting the change in habit helped his health.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The band's first album received mixed reviews and sold poorly. Their second album, released two years later, topped the charts in its first week.
options: The band never released a second album.
Both albums sold the same number of copies.
The band's popularity grew between their first and second albums.
The band broke up after their first album.
quests.correctAnswer: The band's popularity grew between their first and second albums.
quests.hint: Compare how each album performed.
quests.explanation: The first album sold poorly, but the second one topped the charts, showing the band's popularity increased over time.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Every evening, Hana takes her dog to the same park. This week, she noticed the dog no longer pulls on the leash and walks calmly beside her.
options: The dog refuses to go on walks now.
The dog's behavior on walks has improved.
Hana stopped taking her dog for walks.
The park closed down this week.
quests.correctAnswer: The dog's behavior on walks has improved.
quests.hint: Think about how the dog's walking behavior changed.
quests.explanation: The dog used to pull on the leash but now walks calmly, showing an improvement in its behavior during walks.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Jamal used to arrive at meetings five minutes late. After his manager spoke with him privately, he has arrived early to every meeting for the past month.
options: The conversation with his manager likely changed Jamal's habit.
Jamal still arrives late to every meeting.
Jamal's manager stopped attending meetings.
Being on time made no difference to Jamal.
quests.correctAnswer: The conversation with his manager likely changed Jamal's habit.
quests.hint: Notice what happened right before Jamal's habit changed.
quests.explanation: Jamal's lateness stopped right after his manager talked to him, suggesting that conversation was the reason for his new habit.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The coffee shop used to close at 6 p.m. every day. After adding evening study hours for students, the shop now stays open until 10 p.m. and is often full at 9.
options: Extending the hours attracted more evening customers.
The coffee shop closed down completely.
Students stopped visiting the coffee shop.
The coffee shop went back to closing at 6 p.m.
quests.correctAnswer: Extending the hours attracted more evening customers.
quests.hint: Think about who the coffee shop attracted after changing its hours.
quests.explanation: After staying open later for students, the shop became busy in the evenings, showing the longer hours brought in more customers.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Grandpa Tom used to forget his grandchildren's birthdays every year. This year, he wrote each date on a calendar and sent every card exactly on time.
options: Grandpa Tom forgot every birthday again this year.
Grandpa Tom stopped sending birthday cards.
Calendars do not help people remember dates.
Writing down the dates helped Grandpa Tom remember the birthdays.
quests.correctAnswer: Writing down the dates helped Grandpa Tom remember the birthdays.
quests.hint: Look at what Grandpa Tom did differently this year.
quests.explanation: By writing the dates on a calendar, Grandpa Tom managed to send every card on time, unlike in previous years.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The library was almost silent during exam week. Nearly every seat was taken, and students were focused on their notes and laptops.
options: The library was completely empty that week.
Many students were using the library to prepare for exams.
Students ignored their exams that week.
The library closed during exam week.
quests.correctAnswer: Many students were using the library to prepare for exams.
quests.hint: Think about why the library would be full and quiet during exam week.
quests.explanation: A full, quiet library with focused students during exam week shows that many students were there to study.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The store's loyalty card offers a discount after ten purchases. Since introducing the card, cashiers have noticed the same customers returning several times a week.
options: The loyalty card made customers shop less often.
The store removed the loyalty card program.
Customers never returned to the store after signing up.
The loyalty card may be encouraging customers to shop more often.
quests.correctAnswer: The loyalty card may be encouraging customers to shop more often.
quests.hint: Think about how the discount might affect how often people shop.
quests.explanation: Customers began returning more often after the loyalty card was introduced, suggesting the discount is encouraging repeat visits.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: After the software update, several users reported that their laptops now start up in under ten seconds, compared to nearly a minute before.
options: The update made the laptops start up more slowly.
The laptops stopped turning on completely.
Startup speed was not affected by the update.
The update made the laptops start up faster.
quests.correctAnswer: The update made the laptops start up faster.
quests.hint: Compare the startup times before and after the update.
quests.explanation: Startup time dropped from nearly a minute to under ten seconds after the update, showing a clear improvement in speed.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The small coastal town used to see few visitors outside of summer. After a well-known chef opened a restaurant there, tour buses began arriving even in the winter months.
options: The restaurant closed shortly after opening.
The town stopped allowing visitors in winter.
The new restaurant likely brought more visitors to the town.
Tour buses avoided the town completely.
quests.correctAnswer: The new restaurant likely brought more visitors to the town.
quests.hint: Notice what changed in the town right after the restaurant opened.
quests.explanation: Winter visitors began arriving only after the well-known restaurant opened, suggesting it played a role in attracting them.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Priya used to skip breakfast most mornings and often felt dizzy by 11 a.m. Since she started eating eggs and toast every morning, the dizziness has not returned.
options: Eating breakfast made Priya feel dizzier.
Eating breakfast likely helped stop Priya's dizziness.
Priya stopped eating breakfast completely.
Priya's dizziness had no connection to her eating habits.
quests.correctAnswer: Eating breakfast likely helped stop Priya's dizziness.
quests.hint: Compare what happened before and after Priya changed her morning routine.
quests.explanation: Priya's dizziness stopped once she began eating breakfast regularly, suggesting the meal was helping her body throughout the morning.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The community theater's last three plays were performed to half-empty rooms. Their newest play, a comedy, has already sold out for the next two weekends.
options: The new comedy is attracting more interest than the theater's recent plays.
The new comedy sold fewer tickets than earlier plays.
The theater cancelled the upcoming performances.
The theater has stopped performing plays.
quests.correctAnswer: The new comedy is attracting more interest than the theater's recent plays.
quests.hint: Compare ticket sales for the new play with the previous ones.
quests.explanation: While earlier plays only half-filled the theater, the new comedy has already sold out two weekends, showing much stronger interest.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Every year, the Chen family plants tomatoes in their backyard garden. This year, after adding a new type of fertilizer, their tomato plants grew nearly twice as tall as last year's.
options: The new fertilizer stunted the tomato plants' growth.
The new fertilizer likely helped the tomato plants grow taller.
The Chen family stopped growing tomatoes this year.
Fertilizer has no effect on plant growth.
quests.correctAnswer: The new fertilizer likely helped the tomato plants grow taller.
quests.hint: Think about what changed in the garden this year compared to last year.
quests.explanation: The tomato plants grew much taller only after the family used a new fertilizer, suggesting the fertilizer helped their growth.
